mapper.select: SELECT gp.genetic_profile_id AS molecularProfileId, gp.stable_id AS stableId, gp.cancer_study_id AS cancerStudyId, cs.cancer_study_identifier AS cancerStudyIdentifier, gp.genetic_alteration_type AS molecularAlterationType, gp.datatype AS datatype, gp.name AS name, gp.description AS description, gp.show_profile_in_analysis_tab AS showProfileInAnalysisTab, gp.pivot_threshold AS pivotThreshold, gp.sort_order AS sortOrder, gp.generic_assay_type AS genericAssayType, gp.patient_level AS patientLevel FROM genetic_profile gp INNER JOIN cancer_study cs ON gp.cancer_study_id = cs.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN reference_genome rg ON cs.reference_genome_id = rg.reference_genome_id WHERE gp.genetic_alteration_type = 'GENERIC_ASSAY' ORDER BY gp.stable_id

SELECT gp.stable_id AS stableId, gp.datatype AS datatype, cs.cancer_study_identifier AS cancerStudyIdentifier FROM genetic_profile gp INNER JOIN cancer_study cs ON gp.cancer_study_id = cs.cancer_study_id WHERE gp.genetic_alteration_type = #{alterationType} AND gp.datatype != 'CONTINUOUS' AND cs.cancer_study_identifier IN ( SELECT DISTINCT sd.cancer_study_identifier FROM sample_derived sd WHERE ) ORDER BY gp.stable_id
